accuracyFlags: 'State forests in Victoria, NSW and Queensland permit dispersed camping free of charge in most areas': wrong for Queensland, where state forest camping needs a booked permit and per-person fee (about $7.25 in 2025; QPWS), and some NSW forests require permits/fees.
'Camping outside designated areas in a national park is an offence in every state': overstated; several states allow permitted or remote/bush camping in parks.
'Sleeping is generally fine' at rest areas and a '72 hours' stay maximum are asserted with no state source or date; limits differ by state and sign.
Legal page with no official links, no fine amounts and no 2026 dating.
